Use case: scientific-educational. ONE full-resolution 1024x1536 portrait exercise illustration for SEATED DUMBBELL SHOULDER PRESS, frame 1 SET UP. The input is the canonical anatomy illustration: use exactly the same adult bald faceless white/light-grey muscular mannequin, anatomical proportions, crisp thin dark contours, polished 2D shading, white shoes and black background. The reference is STYLE AND CHARACTER only, not the requested pose.
Full body in a fixed front three-quarter view, turned slightly to viewer's left so both grips remain visible. Seated upright against a dark, near-vertical padded gym backrest with head, back and pelvis supported, feet flat and slightly apart on the floor. Two identical modest black round dumbbells in closed overhand grips at shoulder height. Elbows bent approximately 90 degrees, slightly in front of the frontal plane, both wrists stacked directly above elbows, palms facing forward. No leaning or back arch. Clearly visible rigid dumbbell handles through closed hands, matching head sizes and identical plate counts. Fixed bench with sensible support legs and horizontal seat; both feet fully visible.
Deltoids strongest saturated purple, triceps lighter lilac, upper pectorals subtle pale secondary tint. All other body regions white/light-grey with intact anatomy and no bulk changes. Featureless neutral mannequin treatment of lower torso matching the canonical reference. This is a clinical, nonsexual exercise guide.
Compose with generous black space above the dumbbells for the later overhead extension; full arms and weights must remain inside this same crop in every future frame. About 15 percent top margin. Sharp clean individual illustration, no text, numbers, arrows, logos, watermarks, extra objects, second person, collage, or panels. Return exactly one image.
